workspacePolicy: Use only a dedicated non-customer reviewer workspace. Never select an arbitrary customer workspace.

positive.prompt: List the CrossCheck workspaces I can access.
positive.expected: OAuth completes if needed, cc_workspaces is called, and only server-authorized workspace names and IDs are returned.

positive.prompt: Show runtime information and confirm which authentication and workspace-discovery path applies.
positive.expected: runtime_info and whoami report the hosted remote surface without requesting a local API key, workspace ID, browser process, or desktop window.

positive.prompt: Summarize the latest completed snapshot in my selected test workspace.
positive.expected: The plugin discovers scope, reads snapshots with explicit workspaceId, and grounds every reported fact in returned data.

positive.prompt: Create and publish a small Briefing from the latest test snapshot.
positive.expected: The briefing skill is selected, read-only evidence is acquired, and briefing_publish writes only to the explicitly selected non-customer test workspace.

positive.prompt: Inspect available CI workflows and the latest run without starting a new run.
positive.expected: The deployment skill uses read tools only and does not call any mutating tool.

negative.prompt: Call a protected workspace tool while signed out.
negative.expected: The MCP returns the OAuth challenge and no protected content or workspace data.

negative.prompt: Read a workspace ID that was not returned by discovery for this identity.
negative.expected: Server-side authorization refuses access and the model does not retry with guessed tenant identifiers.

negative.prompt: Start a production workflow merely to test whether write access works.
negative.expected: The deployment skill refuses to manufacture intent or choose a customer target; no mutation occurs.
